tafseel: Achanak bukhaar ka pehla ilaj — jaise thandi hawa lagne, dar, ya sadme ke baad. Bukhaar raat ke waqt achanak charhta hai, bechaini hoti hai, pyaas zyada hoti hai.
dosage: 3 goliyan har 2 ghantay baad (bukhaar utrne tak)
rubric_english: Fever; sudden onset, after cold dry wind. Fear; anxiety, restlessness.

tafseel: Tez bukhaar, laal chehra, dhak dhak karta sar dard, soojha hua gala. Achanak shuru hota hai — jaise soojan aur garmi ki alamat ho.
rubric_english: Fever; high, burning, red face. Headache; throbbing, pulsating. Throat; swelling, red.

tafseel: Khushk khansi aur bukhaar jo hilne-chalne se barhta hai. Mareez ko tashreef rakhna pasand hai, zyada pyaas lagti hai, pait sakht aur dard hota hai.
rubric_english: Cough; dry, worse motion. Fever; worse movement. Thirst; large quantity.

tafseel: Gaarha (thick) zukam aur khansi — khaas kar jis mein rang badalta rehta hai. Mareez narm dil, aaram chahta hai, thandi jagah pasand karta hai. Khane ke baad pait kharab hota hai.
rubric_english: Coryza; thick, bland, changing. Cough; worse evening, dry at night. Mild, weepy temperament.

tafseel: Paani jaisa zukam jo aankhon se bhi paani nikale — jaise pyaaz kaatne se ho. Cheenkain aati rehti hain, naak ka paani jalta hai.
rubric_english: Coryza; acrid, watery, profuse. Sneezing; frequent. Eyes; watering, bland discharge.

tafseel: Flu jaisa bukhaar jis mein kamzori aur thakan sab se zyada ho. Mareez sust, ungh se bhara, sar peechay se dard karta hai, hiltay mein kaanpta hai.
rubric_english: Fever; with weakness, trembling. Dullness, drowsiness. Headache; occipital.

tafseel: Bukhaar jis ke sath haddiyon mein bohat dard ho — 'bone break fever'. Sardi ke daur se pehle haddi dard shuru hota hai, pyaas lagti hai.
rubric_english: Fever; bone pains, aching. Chill preceded by thirst. Intermittent fever.

tafseel: Dast aur ulti jis mein kamzori, bechaini aur ghabrahat ho. Pait jalta hai, mareez thanda paani chhota chhota peeta hai, raat ko bura hota hai.
rubric_english: Diarrhoea; watery, offensive, with restlessness. Burning pains. Anxiety; health.

tafseel: Zyada khane, masaledar khane ya ghalat khanay se pait kharab. Bhaari pait, qe aana, charcha (irritability). Neend kharab aur subah susti.
rubric_english: Stomach; from overeating, rich food. Nausea. Irritable. Sleep; disturbed, morning drowsiness.

tafseel: Joron aur haddiyon ka dard jo aaram par zyada aur hilne ke baad kam hota hai. Raat ki khushk khansi. Khujli wale zakhm aur daag.
rubric_english: Rheumatism; worse rest, better motion. Cough; dry, night. Skin; itching, vesicular.

tafseel: Bachon ke daant nikalne ka dard, ghussa aur roona. Bacha banta hai, chahat hai lekin kuch pasand nahi aata. Pait dard aur bechain neend.
rubric_english: Teething; painful, irritable. Anger, crossness. Sleep; disturbed, child cries.

tafseel: Bukhaar ke shuruati marhale ka ilaj — jab alamatein halke hon aur pata na chale kya ho. Kamzori aur khoon ki kami mein bhi madadgar.
rubric_english: Fever; first stage, mild, no local symptoms. Anemia. Weakness.
